function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Set versioned=true to return content and a raw-byte sha256 for a conditional edit/write.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a UTF-8 file: replace anchor text (first/occurrence/all) or a line range. function.name: search_files
function.description: Recursively find files matching a glob pattern (e.g. **/*.ts).

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Regex text search over file contents in the workspace (skips .git/node_modules/dist/build). Returns {file,line,column,text} hits.

function.name: repo_tree
function.description: Return the nested file/dir tree of the workspace (skips .git/node_modules/dist/build). Useful for orientation instead of guessing paths.

function.name: symbol_search
function.description: Find symbols (functions/classes/types/consts/imports) by name within the selected file or directory. Prefers matching TypeScript/JavaScript index hits (fallback:false); otherwise uses a heuristic regex fallback (fallback:true).

function.name: repo_map
function.description: Return the cached repository map: file tree, package manifests, entrypoints, test-command hints and languages. Serves incremental invalidation on repo change; pass refresh:true to force a rebuild.

function.name: discover_commands
function.description: Discover the real test/build/lint/typecheck/check commands from the repo (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile, CI workflows, AGENTS.md). Returns tagged discoveries + a strongest-per-kind summary.

function.name: env_snapshot

function.name: exec
function.description: Run a command in the workspace shell and capture its output.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Update the agent's working state — plan, constraints, decisions, facts, and progress tracking. Use this to set a plan before starting work, mark steps complete, add decisions, and record facts. The runtime protects fields like goal and filesChanged.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Set versioned=true to return content and a raw-byte sha256 for a conditional edit/write.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or append UTF-8 content. Supply expectedSha256 from versioned read_file to reject stale content; on conflict, reread and recalculate.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a UTF-8 file: replace anchor text (first/occurrence/all) or a line range. Supply expectedSha256 from versioned read_file to reject stale content; on conflict, reread and recalculate. profile=strict requires a version for ranges/repeated anchors. Default compatibility permits unversioned edits. Returns a diff.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Recursively find files matching a glob pattern (e.g. **/*.ts).

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Regex text search over file contents in the workspace (skips .git/node_modules/dist/build). Returns {file,line,column,text} hits.

function.name: repo_tree
function.description: Return the nested file/dir tree of the workspace (skips .git/node_modules/dist/build). Useful for orientation instead of guessing paths.

function.name: symbol_search
function.description: Find symbols (functions/classes/types/consts/imports) by name within the selected file or directory. Prefers matching TypeScript/JavaScript index hits (fallback:false); otherwise uses a heuristic regex fallback (fallback:true).

function.name: repo_map
function.description: Return the cached repository map: file tree, package manifests, entrypoints, test-command hints and languages. Serves incremental invalidation on repo change; pass refresh:true to force a rebuild.

function.name: discover_commands
function.description: Discover the real test/build/lint/typecheck/check commands from the repo (package.json, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile, CI workflows, AGENTS.md). Returns tagged discoveries + a strongest-per-kind summary.

function.name: env_snapshot
function.description: Capture the environment capability snapshot once (OS, cwd, runtime versions, package manager, git state, tool list, harness profile, network policy). Secrets-safe: env VALUES are never captured; network policy is supplied, not probed.

function.name: exec
function.description: Run a command in the workspace shell and capture its output.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Update the agent's working state — plan, constraints, decisions, facts, and progress tracking. Use this to set a plan before starting work, mark steps complete, add decisions, and record facts. The runtime protects fields like goal and filesChanged.
